summary: Executed backend pytest contract checks plus mobile-web Playwright runs for guest onboarding, Home↔Reader morph, and Reader ending actions. Core flows load and run, but transition still has a visible title handoff gap and overlay-stuck behavior after quick back.

minor.issue: EXPO_BACKEND_URL key was not present; tests required remapping from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to run

ui_bugs.issue: rAF sampling shows frames where both title layers are near-invisible (390x844: 6 frames; 375x667: 5 frames), matching user-reported title disappear/reappear
After quick back from intro, morph overlay remains mounted on Home (overlay count stayed 1)

integration_issues.flow: Reader reopen immediately after quick back
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent failure to re-enter deep-dive in automation; one run also logged Metro disconnect mid-sequence
Web click handler exercised without runtime errors; native share sheet itself is not browser-verifiable

issues: Touch targets validated at 104x44 for like/save/share (meets minimum)
Base icon layers rendered transparent (no white background artifacts detected in web preview)

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns selected easing unsupported on web and falls back to linear, so browser frame timing is only a proxy for native smoothness

action_items: Fix morph title complementary fade so at least one title stays visible every frame.
Ensure story-morph overlay unmounts reliably after intro quick-back (both 390x844 and 375x667).
Re-verify rapid back/reopen stability after overlay fix; include chapter-back simple navigation check.
Keep native performance validation on real device before any 60fps claims.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend env naming drift: expected EXPO_BACKEND_URL but file currently exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; align to single canonical key to avoid tooling/test ambiguity.
Morph host/close path likely has a race where overlay clear is not guaranteed on fast return.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral guest test users were auto-created via /api/user/{uuid} during tests (no real account mutation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use testIDs directly: onboarding-profile-continue -> chip-all -> onboarding-continue for deterministic guest-to-home. For ending checks, rely on deep-dive-actions boundingClientRect visibility (not just DOM presence) and advance with wheel gestures until y enters viewport.
rca_of_issue: Repro: open story from Home, then back quickly from intro. Observed story-morph remains mounted (count=1) and rAF samples show transient dual-title invisibility. Likely close-commit/host-dismiss race around fast intro return where opacity handoff and overlay teardown overlap. Mitigation: enforce single-source state machine for morph phases and guarantee teardown on route settle/back completion.
